90396.overview:
Chamberoids is a video game published by Megastar games and released on the Memotech MTX500/512 and RS128 in 1985.
It was created by Chris Sawyer.

91196.overview: Continental Raiders (Cosmic Raiders in-Game) is a variant of Space Invaders. The game retains most aspects of the original arcade game and has the player moving left and right down the bottom of the screen while trying to shoot down the alien invaders that move back and forth above. There are three kinds of aliens (evil lurchers, wicked ogres and swamp vipers) each worth different point values and they fire a large amount of projectiles that the player has to dodge. Like in the arcade game barriers offer some protection and there is a mother ship moving past at the top of the screen. One difference is that the mother ship here shoots fast moving missiles. The player has three lives and is given an extra one at 1000 points.

91225.overview: Cobra is a Snake style game, published by XAP for the Memotech MTX home computer.

135975.overview: You find yourself in a land where magic forces prevail. You must battle through the trials that await, encountering strange people and objects on your quest fot the fabled Orb.

135991.overview: A chess simulation where the player plays against the computer. It includes ten levels of play, from novice to championship standard. Features include user defined piece and board colours, mistake detection facility, standard board notation, analytic mode, next move computer generated suggestions plus fast machine move execution times.
